text: Harbour City ने पहले हाफ में Elias Okafor और Marek Barros की गोलों से 2-0 की बढ़त बनाई, हालांकि ये दोनों मौके आसान थे (xG लगभग 0.125 और 0.009) [#905] [#975]. पर Seabrook Town ने दूसरे हाफ में जोरदार वापसी की, खासकर Kian Romano के दो गोलों के साथ जो मैच के आखिरी मिनटों में बड़े मौके (xG 0.605 और 0.952) बनाए [#1882] [#1906]. Seabrook Town ने ज्यादा शॉट्स लगाए (22 बनाम 10) और ज्यादा बार गोल के करीब पहुंचे, जो उनकी बेहतर तैयारी दर्शाता है [#905] [#1104]. उनका कोच खेल के बीच में रणनीति बदलकर तेज प्रेशर और डायरेक्ट खेल पर जोर दिया, जिससे टीम ने अपनी ताकत दिखाई [#1361] [#1884]. Harbour City के Marek Barros ने शानदार प्रदर्शन किया, 1 गोल, 2 असिस्ट और कई बचाव किए, लेकिन टीम को जीत नहीं दिला सके [#975].

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in hi

- Seabrook Town won 4-2 with significantly higher xG of 3.44 versus Harbour City's 1.03, showing better quality chances [#evidence 905,975,1104].
- Harbour City led 2-0 early in the second half with goals at 45' and 47', both low xG but effective finishing [#evidence 905,975].
- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals after the 53' mark, including two late goals by Kian Romano in stoppage time with high xG (0.605 and 0.952) [#evidence 1882,1906].
- Harbour City had fewer shots (10 vs 22) and shots on target (5 vs 9), indicating Seabrook Town dominated attack [#evidence 905,1104].
- Marek Barros from Harbour City was player of the match despite losing, with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a 9.8 rating [#evidence 975].

- Seabrook Town’s late comeback and dominance reflect a tactical shift toward higher pressing and more direct play, as indicated by their coach’s instructions at 65' and 90+2' to press higher and increase directness and line height. This adjustment allowed them to recover possession more aggressively and exploit transitions quickly, especially in the final stages of the match (#1361, #1884).

- Harbour City’s initial patient short passing style, using a 4-2-3-1 formation, is shown in their 56.9-second 17-pass buildup leading to Elias Okafor’s equalizer at 45', signaling a methodical possession-based approach focused on creating openings through sustained buildup (#905).

- Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 formation and wide, crossing style are evident in Marek Barros’ unusual long-range cross-goal at 47' for Harbour City, and in the multiple goals scored following quick regains leading to through balls, especially the quick regains resulting directly in chances by Tariq Marlowe (53'), Callum Varga (69'), and Kian Romano’s counter-attack goal (90+2') (#975, #1104, #1448, #1882).

- The high turnovers for Seabrook Town (25 total) indicate their pressing aggressiveness, matching their lower ppda (5.5) compared to Harbour City's 7.6, supporting the observation that Seabrook Town prioritized disrupting possession to launch fast wide attacks and crosses, fitting their formation and style (#team_stats).
